title.narrative: Commonwealth Election Professionals Initiative – Phase IV

description.narrative: The CEP approach and methodology has been refined across three project phases and proven successful in translating impact from an individual (participating election professional) to an institutional level (their parent EMB). The primary project delivery mechanism is the conduct of in-person regional training events, utilising world class expertise and facilitation to deliver tailored training programmes which address key regional needs and priorities. Post-training event, participants continue to benefit from ongoing peer support and knowledge exchange through the CEP Alumni Network. 1) Evidence: The effectiveness and impact of the CEP approach and methodology is evidenced by the three previous project cycles (findings of the June 2025 CEP Annual Impact & Evaluation Survey) * 60% of CEP Alumni ‘strongly agreed’ that participation had increased their effectiveness and ability as an electoral administrator, with 67% reporting a marked increase in their understanding of international standards for the conduct of credible, inclusive and transparent elections. * 71% of CEP alumni ‘strongly agreed’ that participation has had a positive impact on their career, with 44% reporting that they had been promoted or assigned new/additional responsibilities. * 91% of CEP alumni have stayed in touch with their fellow participants, with 45% reporting that they had sought elections-related advice from the CEP Network within the last 12 months. * 42% of CEP alumni report that their EMB has enhanced the credibility, inclusiveness and transparency of its electoral processes as a result of their recommendations, demonstrating CEP’s success in translating impact from individual to institutional levels. 2) Programme level impact: Through raising CEP participant capacity, understanding and application of international electoral best practice, CEP alumni are equipped to review existing/draft new EMB policies and procedures which enhance the credibility, inclusiveness and transparency of their electoral processes. 3) COMSEC comparative advantage: the success & impact of the CEP Initiative is in creating a platform for open and meaningful exchange of knowledge, experience and practice. As a trusted partner (with no agenda other than facilitating the exchange through world-class expertise), ComSec is uniquely positioned as delivery partner.
